comparison.objective: Cut a dead rose stem above a bud and place the retained cutting in a bin; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Plant identification, shear placement, cutting, and continuous offcut retention versus precision fastener and collar manipulation.
comparison.success_condition: Correct first-cut location, undamaged bud/live stems, and no dropped cutting; candidate requires two safe physical impact cycles.
comparison.reason: Pruning and controlled offcut handling are meaningfully different abilities.
